subject: E-Commerce
title: AR Try-Before-You-Buy
description: A micro-lesson that makes AR Try-Before-You-Buy usable.

hook.text: IKEA's AR app lets you place a virtual sofa in your living room. Returns dropped 35% for furniture bought using AR.

buildup.text: The biggest problem in online shopping is uncertainty: will it fit, does it match, will it look good in real life?

discovery.text: Warby Parker's virtual try-on uses your phone camera to show how glasses look on your face in real-time.

twist.text: AR try-on technology exists but adoption is low. Only 1% of shoppers regularly use AR before purchasing.

climax.text: AR solves the confidence gap in online shopping. The technology works; changing habits takes longer.

punchline.text: 35% fewer returns with AR try-on. The tech works; consumers just haven't.

quiz.question: How did IKEA's AR app reduce returns?
options: Customers could visualize furniture in their actual rooms before buying, reducing surprises
